title: "Men vs Women"

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/data-prep.R")
```

## Two events, one Olympic stage

Beach volleyball has featured men's and women's tournaments at every Games since its 1996 debut. Participation below is measured in athlete-event records—two records for each competing pair—while medal bars count podium teams once.

### Participation through the years

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Beach volleyball athlete-event records by gender and Summer Games."

ggplot(
  beach_participation_by_year,
  aes(x = year, y = athlete_event_records, color = gender, group = gender)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Men = "#147f91", Women = "#c99837")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(beach_participation_by_year$year))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Athlete-event records",
    color = "Event",
    caption = "Source: olympicAthletes::olympic_athletes; beach volleyball identified from the event field."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#637780", hjust = 0)
  )
```

### Who reached the podium?

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Countries winning beach volleyball team medals by edition and event."

beach_medals |>
  mutate(
    country = factor(country, levels = rev(country_medal_totals$country))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = country, fill = medal)) +
  geom_tile(width = 0.86, height = 0.88, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~gender, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Gold = "#c99837", Silver = "#9caab5", Bronze = "#b87950"),
    breaks = c("Gold", "Silver", "Bronze")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Medal",
    caption = "Each tile represents one medal-winning country-team. 2020 and 2024 podiums are sourced from official Olympic results."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#10384a"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#637780", hjust = 0)
  )
```
